description: US-025 required eleven hours, 57 changed files, and 47 commits because an oversized functional story entered execution together with mutation-tool hardening; its initial feature phase alone lasted 3 hours 13 minutes and repeated source changes invalidated cold campaigns. It should centrally enforce every normal hard limit: at most 120 estimated minutes, one primary outcome, three major scopes, two routes/screens, three acceptance flows, 20 expected files, one lifecycle/concurrency boundary, no combined functional delivery and tooling/framework change, no unbudgeted unresolved uncertainty, and no unofficial or unresolved work-item ID. Functional and technical changes use the same gate: partition functional work by vertical user/business outcomes and technical work by independently verifiable operational outcomes; mixed work is never an exemption. Generated packages should carry canonical payload digests and approval evidence and enforce the same decision through every agent entry point, the commit hook, staged and Git-range validation, and the repository gate, while generated CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md guidance keeps the rule durable. At 45 minutes require on-track/variance evidence; at 90 minutes stop incomplete implementation and return it for official partitioning. Calibration must retain actual phase minutes, total, changed files, commits, review-fix loops, authoritative cold attempts, source-change invalidations, estimate variance, and root cause, then use historical project evidence to recommend better outcome boundaries, phase budgets, and further safe cold-shard/graph optimization.
